validated_candidates.claim: A long, narrow, deep life line without irregularities promises long life, good health, and vitality.
validated_candidates.source_quote: The line of life should be long, narrow, and deep, without irregularities, breaks, or crosses of any kind. Such a formation promises long life, good health, and vitality.

validated_candidates.claim: A chained or linked life line is a sign of bad health.
validated_candidates.source_quote: When the line is linked or made up of little pieces like a chain, it is a sure sign of bad health

validated_candidates.claim: A chained life line on a soft hand is an especially strong sign of bad health.
validated_candidates.source_quote: it is a sure sign of bad health, and particularly so on a soft hand

validated_candidates.claim: A life line starting from the base of the Mount of Jupiter denotes a life of ambition from the earliest years.
validated_candidates.source_quote: When the line starts from the base of the Mount of Jupiter, instead of the side of the hand, it denotes that from the earliest the life has been one of ambition.

validated_candidates.claim: A life line chained at its commencement under Jupiter foreshadows bad health in early life.
validated_candidates.source_quote: When the line is chained at the commencement under Jupiter, bad health in early life is foreshadowed.

validated_candidates.claim: An island on the life line indicates illness or loss of health for the duration of the island.
validated_candidates.source_quote: An island on the line of life means an illness or loss of health while the island lasts

validated_candidates.claim: A clearly formed island at the commencement of the life line denotes some mystery connected with the subject's birth.
validated_candidates.source_quote: a clearly formed island at the commencement of the line of life denotes some mystery connected with the subject's birth

validated_candidates.claim: A square enclosing a break in the life line indicates preservation from sudden death.
validated_candidates.source_quote: The line running through a square indicates preservation from death, from sudden death when the life-line running through is broken

validated_candidates.claim: A square found on the life line is a mark of preservation.
validated_candidates.source_quote: A square, whenever found on the line of life, is a mark of preservation.

validated_candidates.claim: A full, smooth Mount of Venus indicates a person less affected by those with whom they associate.
validated_candidates.source_quote: the full, smooth Mount of Venus indicates that the individual is less affected by those with whom he is associated

validated_candidates.claim: A life line sweeping widely into the palm, giving the Mount of Venus greater scope, is a sign of good physical strength and long life.
validated_candidates.source_quote: When the line of life sweeps far out into the hand, thus allowing the Mount of Venus a greater scope, it is in itself a sign of good physical strength and long life.
validated_candidates.source_fidelity: S(this session): reduced to single sweep antecedent; Cheiro p139 treats Venus scope as a consequence of the sweep, not an independent condition. Prior 2-antecedent encoding over-restricted.

validated_candidates.claim: A life line lying very close to the Mount of Venus indicates a less robust constitution and physically less well-built body.
validated_candidates.source_quote: When it lies very close to the Mount of Venus, health is not so robust or the body physically so well built.

validated_candidates.claim: A short life line indicates a shorter natural term of life, apart from accidental influences.
validated_candidates.source_quote: The shorter the line the shorter the life.
